name: Surrender
description: Gameplay change (off by default; Other Empires page, Gameplay changes). A badly crippled AI ship (less than 45% of its components working, and no way to run: engines out, or slower than what is shooting at it and unable to jump away) that is outgunned (the ships shooting at it have 1.5 times its own firepower) may strike its colours instead of fighting to the death. The chance each check depends on its people's temper (cautious races give in sooner, aggressive ones fight on). A ship that has struck stops fighting and moving, leaves its fleet and is no longer fired at; the nearest armed enemy puts a prize crew aboard within 20 seconds (reusing the original's boarding capture: the empire's capture policy decides whether the ship is kept, retrofitted or scrapped). Nobody comes: after 120 game days its crew takes it back. Your own ships never surrender on their own.
